svg.title: Type hint forms and the checker rules that matter most
svg.desc: Infographic explaining Python type hint forms, checker rules including Postel's Law and Any versus object, gradual typing runtime behavior, and CI enforcement.
svg.text: Type hint forms and the checker rules that matter most

text.tspan: Iterable[Node] | None (3.10+ union; Optional[X] is
X | None): the checker forces you to handle None;
narrow with if x is not None, isinstance, assert x
or an early return
Callable[[], T] with TypeVar T for a function that
keeps the type it receives

svg.text: NewType(Port, int): a distinct type for the checker

text.tspan: TypedDict(total=False): the shape of a dict; zero
runtime validation, a from_json returning arbitrary
JSON passes at runtime unless you validate with
pydantic
TypeAlias: JsonScalar = str | int | float | bool |
None
@overload: several signatures plus one unannotated
implementation, for sum and max with or without
key= and default=

svg.text: Self types fluent methods and classmethods

text.tspan: Annotated[int, Field(ge=0)] attaches metadata for
pydantic and FastAPI
Postel's Law:
accept general types (Iterable,
Sequence, Mapping), return concrete list or dict;
do not annotate a read-only parameter as dict or
list when Mapping, Sequence or Iterable will do;
name2hex(name: str, color_map: Mapping[str, int])
accepts dict, defaultdict, ChainMap or UserDict
Any versus object:
Any is both a subtype and a
supertype of every type, so it turns checking off
and the effect spreads, as with json.loads(); object
accepts any value but allows only operations every
object supports until you narrow it; typing.cast
and # type: ignore[code] switch off checking for
that line
CPython ignores hints at runtime and stores them in __annotations__; mypy, pyright, pyre, pytype read them;
unannotated functions are ignored by default; keep fixed-length tuple[str, float, str] separate from
tuple[int, ...]; TYPE_CHECKING blocks for annotation-only imports; reveal_type(x); get_type_hints(func)
and inspect.signature(func) read lazy annotations
annotate public APIs first, then mypy --strict, per-module overrides (ignore_missing_imports for redfish.* and
paramiko.*), stubgen, types-requests; new errors fail the build

svg.text: Typing pays off most at boundaries: API clients, config models and plugin interfaces
